name: dev-toolkit
description: A developer toolkit of hooks, skills, agents and MCP servers for Claude Code

restore_context.title: Restore context after compaction
restore_context.description: After the conversation is compacted, re-add your own messages and the git state so Claude keeps your decisions.

audit_config.title: Audit config changes
audit_config.description: Log every change to settings and skill files (setting names only) and undo ones that would turn off hooks, remove protected-file deny rules, disable dev-toolkit or bypass permissions.

log_actions.title: Log Claude's actions
log_actions.description: Keep an audit trail of every command Claude runs and every file it changes (no file contents or output; secrets masked).
